g.text: FL701: all drawn functional symbols have observed command matches
Green regions show correspondence, not exact phosphor boundaries. Hover for commands.
Observed optical-core union, composed from separate one-hot captures
Not a simultaneous all-on test. Drawing and camera spacing differ; compare symbols, not global pixel overlap.
770 matrix dots + 28 meter shapes + 16 channel pads + 23 red strokes + 24 legends/index symbols = 861 entries
861 entries share 846 commands. Whole legends count once; coupled dots, strokes and MONO/index 2 count separately.
No unmatched reference symbol found. Does not prove unused bits, exact boundaries, electrical safety or absence of faint ghosting.
